deterministic_classification.TRIANGULATED_HIGH_PRIORITY: Phase4A Tier A; plausible topology; HUCMSC_SECRETOME_DIRECT; >=1 independent EMPIRICAL_REVERSAL_SUPPORTED R1/R2A axis; no empirical disease-concordant/conflict axis; no direct HUCMSC/MSC-PE mechanism already shown
deterministic_classification.TRIANGULATED_CONTEXT_DEPENDENT: plausible topology plus direct hUCMSC or other-MSC extracellular protein evidence plus empirical reversal evidence, but Phase4A/empirical receiver-specific sign conflict exists
deterministic_classification.COMPUTATIONAL_ONLY: no independent extracellular protein support and no independent empirical reversal support
deterministic_classification.BIOPHYSICALLY_WEAK_PARACRINE: topology is MEMBRANE_ASSOCIATED, INTRACELLULAR_OR_QUESTIONABLE_PARACRINE, or UNCERTAIN

gate_rule.GO_TO_FINAL_SYNTHESIS: >=2 TRIANGULATED_HIGH_PRIORITY candidates and no critical provenance risk
gate_rule.GO_TO_FINAL_SYNTHESIS_WITH_RESTRICTIONS: >=1 TRIANGULATED_HIGH_PRIORITY or >=2 TRIANGULATED_CONTEXT_DEPENDENT candidates with valid evidence extraction
gate_rule.REVISE_CANDIDATE_FRAMEWORK: no high-priority and <2 context-dependent candidates, but some external evidence is reusable
gate_rule.NO_GO_MECHANISTIC_PRIORITIZATION: no credible independent extracellular protein or perturbation evidence, or critical freeze/provenance failure
